ordinaryGlasses.definition: Visual PASS reviews explicitly describe ordinary/clear eyeglasses or readable eyeglass lenses. The candidate eyeglasses model score is not used as a ground-truth label. H231 colored contact lenses excluded.

paintOrFaceMarkings.definition: Visual PASS reviews explicitly describe face paint, paint-like coating or facial markings. This named challenge subset is not a census of all makeup.

recommendation: Do not add a blanket full-frame admission veto based on this 360-image exploration. Use full scores as a review-priority signal only; the .05 full-max gate flags 5 visually denied, 45 visually passed and 3 uncertain photos, including 9 allowed ordinary-glasses and 1 readable face-paint examples. The on-head sunglasses example H197 is flagged by the mask output, not a high sunglasses output; H054 remains unflagged. Face-local detail evidence is a separate quality need that cannot be validated by the full-frame attributes.
limitations: Scores are model outputs, not calibrated probabilities.
The 360-image sampler combines random controls with targeted challenge strata; counts are not a population prevalence estimate.
All visual labels are assistant inspection, not independent human verification.
Uncertain rows remain separate and are not counted as true denials or false flags.
The same 360 labels are now used for exploratory analysis; a threshold developed from them needs a new untouched validation set.
A blanket global sharpness threshold was not proposed or changed. Face-local/eye-local sharpness and contrast would need separate evidence and pose/light/clear-glasses/paint controls.
